Cannonball Atari Falcon (CT60 / CT63) port - v0.27 (compiled release)
See VERSION.txt at the root of the repository for the changelog since v0.26.

CB030.TOS - 68030/Falcon (NOT usable on a stock 16 MHz Falcon: far too slow)
CB060.TOS - 68060/CT60 / CT63 (the one to use)
outrun.ini - mod=1, mod_dsp=1 (.mod music played by the DSP; set mod_dsp=0 for CPU mixing,
             mod=0 for the original FM music)
